overview.heading: Terms & Duration
overview.text: There are two regular semesters, each of 22 weeks, in an academic year for all engineering programs. Classes of the spring semester normally start in April and the fall semester in October. Academic activities follow the calendar approved by the Academic Council before each program commences.

note.heading: Please Note
note.text: BAUST reserves the right to change the academic calendar. Always refer to the official documents below for the authoritative schedule.
